name: Dagda
abilities: Divine Ascension — Tír na nÓg Moon-Sovereign Form
passives: Geas Bloom: Dagoran gains Geas when defender play anchors a control zone and converts enemy commitment into mitigation on sídhe-root crossing. At 3 stacks, the next Technique or Reaction adds a geas sovereignty rider; at 5 stacks, the Signature upgrades once and then empties the meter. Momentum feeds the setup, Divinity empowers the finisher, and Earth myth remains only the echo of Avalora.
lore: Dagda, Good God Cauldron-King, is now canonized as one of the four playable deities of Tuatha. The deity is the source-realm divinity behind the mythology rather than a generic champion: Tuatha father god, abundance cauldron, oak club, sovereign feast and protection. All prior faction, realm, civilization, campaign, and Lore Codex canon remains intact; only the playable roster scale and divine identity layer changed.
personality: A playable mythology deity whose behavior expresses Tuatha father god, abundance cauldron, oak club, sovereign feast and protection; confident, sovereign, readable in combat, loyal to the unchanged Tuatha canon.
visualDescription: Dagda manifests as Tuatha father god, abundance cauldron, oak club, sovereign feast and protection from Tuatha: broad warm masculine elder-king face, heavy brow, laughing eyes, thick beard, generous authority; large powerful masculine guardian build, heavy belly-and-chest strength, grounded feast-king posture; signature silhouette: huge club, cauldron shield, fur mantle, broad oak-root stance. Weapon: great life-death oak club and cauldron-lid shield. Maintain the approved Titan Gates premium stylized tactical RPG aesthetic.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Dagoran — Silver-Branch Cut Anchor
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Tuatha source-culture damage at range 2; generate Momentum and a small Geas Memory gain when used from silver-root fae ground or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as silver branches, living oak armor, thorn mantles, standing stones, battle-crow omens, cauldron glow, moonlit green-gold, geas scars.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Titan into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Geas Thorn Technique — Bastion
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to protects a control zone, redirects enemy intent, and turns correct positioning into mitigation. Builds Geas Memory only when the player uses silver-root fae ground intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Dagoran: Sídhe Court Covenant Holdfast
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Geas Memory to impose a two-round rule from Avalora: protects a control zone, redirects enemy intent, and turns correct positioning into mitigation. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Titan, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Tír na nÓg Moon-Sovereign Form
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Geas Memory, transform nearby terrain into silver-root fae ground, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Dagoran Bulwark Lugh Silver-Spear Thornblade
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through silver-root fae ground. Visual: silver branches, living oak armor, thorn mantles, standing stones, battle-crow omens, cauldron glow, moonlit green-gold, geas scars.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Dagoran Moon-Oak Sídhe Mantle
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Titan read as Avalora source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the player followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Dagoran Dagda Cauldron Memory Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Geas Memory and unlocks a mastery branch for Sídhe Mound Slip, Fae Glamour Reversal, and Collect the Geas Debt. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every deity can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.uniqueMechanic: Dagoran's Geas Bloom: a solo mechanic where Geas grows through sídhe-root crossing, reaction-window mastery, and defender decisions that anchor a control zone and convert enemy commitment into mitigation. Payoff: hold objectives longer while redirecting the next revealed enemy intent. Counterplay: spread attackers, displacement, or terrain denial break the anchor; enemies can also drain Momentum/Divinity before the upgraded Signature resolves.
balanceNotes.counterplayRule: spread attackers, displacement, or terrain denial break the anchor
